supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The ridge extends laterally beyond the outer margins of the ocular region, creating a broad horizontal silhouette.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the light-pigmented muzzle/chin area and the significantly darker-pigmented periocular and cheek regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: The lower lip exhibits moderate vertical thickness with a slight structural droop in a resting state.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive white hair/pelage coverage across the chin and mandibular border.
